baseline: one full Native two-bump episode with measured edge feedback, physical grasp and full plan preflight

acceptance.mechanical_connectivity: actual positive weight/gradient eight-node graph with packed histories, including zero-code bridges; evaluate initial, after A and after B
acceptance.home: native recorded grasp and return HOME gates
acceptance.camera_visibility: actual native Global frames: initial, first approach, middle/end A, second approach, middle B, final and HOME; no robot/tool/gripper hiding
acceptance.camera_sync: same episode, identical physics/surface/extrinsics timestamps; measured hand @ fixed v5 mount; fixed Global; actual K/range recorded

conditional_research_budget.when: If original v7 fails real separation, diagnose existing recorded front/contact traces and the failed episode before changing physics
conditional_research_budget.rule: one causally motivated versioned candidate and at most one diagnosed correction; retain original v7/profile byte-identical; no seed search
minimum_controls: original frozen CUT C00 near-cut x/F and roughness comparison
conditional_research_budget.stop: If bounded research still fails, mark two-bump physical delivery and hero BLOCKED, enumerate missing movies; no CUT-only completion claim

materials: Existing cutting_tasks_v1 uncalibrated clay-like recipe; no parameter tuning
media: Re-encode all available old raw cameras; no re-simulation merely for missing encoded wrist panes. Old outputs remain immutable.
visibility_corrections: At most one justified new fixed Global view version after actual recorded frames reveal an issue; no wrist calibration/park changes. Keep failed view evidence.
effective_duration_rule: Existing run_wp13.build: 120 s ideal probe, then ceil((1.1*first_DONE+1)/0.5)*0.5, same compiled controller in both runtimes
amendment: Before any recorded Native frame: first v6 attempt refused registration. v6 independent controls failed coverage and feature gates. Original solver, material, scene, seed, path and all physical thresholds unchanged. Only Global pose changes; optical parameters return to the already validated exact v5 recipe.
